assessments.reasoning: Section 2.1 specifies an alphabetic first character followed by alphabetics, digits, or hyphens, and illustrates differently capitalized names referring to one rule. The §4 rulename production independently spells out the same character sequence using ALPHA and DIGIT.

challenge.method: Checked the exact §2.1 text, §4 production, the later literal-text update, and the errata list including rejected 4361 on angle-bracket wording.
challenge.results: The case rules for identifiers are explicit and distinct from terminal literal matching. The verified §4 errata concern whitespace handling in other productions. The rejected angle-bracket report supplies no contrary identifier rule.

limitations: This review concerns rule-name syntax and identity. Terminal string matching and documentation use of angle brackets have separate semantics.
